system.description: Unlike many who brandish a blade, you have learned to wield yours with grace and dignity. You are a student of martial tradition, a fencer of forms and geometries- iron becomes lightning in your hands. Prowess deeds have the melee keyword, meaning they must be used with a melee weapon, such as a sword or warhammer. Practitioners of this craft excel at dueling single opponents and can adopt stances that empower them for the encounter.
